title: Implement selected cache and plugin correctness improvements
description: Evaluate 30 project improvements; implement canonical action keys, atomic plugin extraction, complete cache repair, rooted source reads, safe concurrent discovery persistence, and streaming local tiered writes. Record rationale and regression evidence in docs/design/2026-10-06-improvement-selection.md.
notes: Implemented seven selected ideas, including malformed-provider diagnostic privacy and runtime environment identity. Full unit/race/vet/build gates and CLI exact-plan/cache smoke passed. Detailed review: docs/design/2026-10-06-improvement-selection.md. Six follow-up issues are open.
close_reason: Selected improvements implemented with regression evidence and full local quality gates; plans, downsides, confidence and remaining work documented.

title: Bound plugin stdin writes and join response readers on cancellation
description: internal/plugin/process.go send writes stdin synchronously before selecting ctx.Done. A non-reading plugin can block a large request indefinitely. Add a helper-process regression with a request exceeding pipe capacity, make write and read cancellation bounded, and verify Close joins all goroutines without races or child leaks.
close_reason: Implemented with regression coverage; full repository race suite, vet, builds, and CLI smoke passed.

title: Preserve artifact modes and restore outputs atomically
description: ActionResult records output digests but no executable mode, and dag.writeFile uses os.Create. Design a versioned mode-bearing receipt, preserve executable permissions on fresh cache restores, and stage output replacements so failed reads do not truncate existing outputs. Cover local and OCI round trips and old-cache policy.
close_reason: Implemented with regression coverage; full repository race suite, vet, builds, and CLI smoke passed.

title: Make implicit dependency ordering stable for exact plan fingerprints
description: Resolve ranges over extraDeps maps when adding cross-target dependency edges. newPlanJSONDocument preserves DependsOn order, so semantically identical plans can hash differently. Sort implicit edges without changing explicit plugin order; add repeated-process plan-digest coverage with multiple implicit producers.
close_reason: Implemented with regression coverage; full repository race suite, vet, builds, and CLI smoke passed.

title: Bound archive expansion and entry counts across extraction paths
description: The tiered cache replay memory portion is delivered in mu-fdq. Remaining work: define shared expanded-byte and entry-count limits across catalog, plugin CAS, and scratch extraction, using representative toolchain sizes. Cover compressed expansion, adversarial boundary tests, and a bounded fuzz corpus. Temporary-disk capacity and abrupt-process replay cleanup policy should be considered separately from memory bounds.

title: Add Linux and macOS continuous validation for execution boundaries
description: Repository has no .github workflow. Add a pinned Go Linux/macOS matrix with unit, race, vet, build and native sandbox acceptance. Qualify new rooted reads and atomic directory publication on Linux. Keep Babashka and real PUDL integration separate from unit test claims.
close_reason: Implemented and qualified by Linux/macOS CI run 37469092000, including native isolation, whole-repository race/vet/build gates, and scoped regressions.

title: Make cache-only plugin version selection explicit
description: Atomic bundle publication retains older versions for running processes. Project resolution and plugin push select exact digests, but cache-only plugin info/list/guide still select by directory order. Define explicit digest or lock-backed selection and report ambiguity; do not infer newest from lexicographic hashes. Also harden legacy single-file extraction with atomic full-digest publication.
close_reason: Implemented and qualified by Linux/macOS CI run 37469092000, including native isolation, whole-repository race/vet/build gates, and scoped regressions.

title: Bound tiered cache replay memory with temporary-file spooling
description: Implement disk-backed write-through and blob read-repair, cancellation checkpoints, digest verification, and cleanup on caller Close. This is the memory portion of mu-rlo; archive budgets remain separate.
close_reason: Implemented with regression coverage; full repository race suite, vet, builds, and CLI smoke passed.

title: Canonicalize OCI action manifest layer ordering
description: Sort output layers by name so repeated publication of identical receipts preserves the manifest digest and does not orphan equivalent manifests.
close_reason: Implemented with regression coverage; full repository race suite, vet, builds, and CLI smoke passed.

title: Define a safe inherited-environment identity contract
description: Nil action environments inherit parent variables but cache identity only records inheritance versus explicit environment. Define a non-secret allowlist or a clean-environment migration; do not hash arbitrary parent secrets. Add hermeticity tests showing relevant allowed environment changes invalidate identity and unrelated/private values do not enter keys or logs.
close_reason: Implemented and qualified by Linux/macOS CI run 37469092000, including native isolation, whole-repository race/vet/build gates, and scoped regressions.

title: Confine action working-directory execution against symlink escapes
description: Resolve checks work_dir lexically before exec.Cmd.Dir follows filesystem symlinks. Design descriptor-backed execution or sandbox enforcement; EvalSymlinks followed by exec still has a swap race. Cover internal symlinks, external links, swaps, and macOS/Linux execution acceptance while preserving intentional direct-command contracts.
close_reason: Implemented and qualified by Linux/macOS CI run 37469092000, including native isolation, whole-repository race/vet/build gates, and scoped regressions.

title: Separate full digest validation from inspection prefixes
description: Inventory ParseDigest callers and accepted algorithms. Add full-identity validation at OCI, plugin resolver, and external protocol boundaries without breaking abbreviated display/inspection references. Test malformed algorithms, invalid hex, wrong lengths, and supported prefix workflows.

title: Bound remote manifest and configuration decoding
description: Choose explicit metadata budgets by artifact kind using representative manifests, separate from large blob limits. Enforce limits before decoding remote OCI action/plugin configs and manifests. Return actionable boundary errors and include malformed, oversized, and fuzz-corpus acceptance cases.
close_reason: Implemented and qualified by Linux/macOS CI run 37469092000, including native isolation, whole-repository race/vet/build gates, and scoped regressions.

title: Keep local builds responsive during optional registry outages
description:
Reproduced against both /Users/chazu/go/bin/mu and source commit ac5e762 using an isolated loopback registry and disposable local caches. With disk first and a read-only OCI second tier, a pure built-in shell action succeeds on a refused connection (about 0.06-0.11 s), and a warm local action hit succeeds without any registry request. A cold action lookup against an HTTP server that accepts connections but never answers remains blocked until the harness kills Mu after 3 s; its local action never creates its output.

The OCI factory leaves auth.Client.Client unset. The pinned ORAS default HTTP client has no total timeout, and optional tiered lookups wait synchronously before falling back. There is no bounded response-header wait for an accepted, silent connection.

Acceptance: builds whose required inputs/plugins/toolchains are available locally must remain responsive during optional registry outages. Bound lookup attempts including authentication/retries, and avoid paying the same outage timeout once per action. Preserve legitimate large streaming transfers rather than imposing an arbitrarily short whole-upload deadline. Cover stalled headers/bodies, refused connections, warm local hits, cold local rebuilds, write-through outages, and parent cancellation. Truly missing required artifacts must return a clear error without silently substituting another plugin/toolchain identity. Explicit push/publish operations must still report failed delivery.

The current diagnostic is an assessment, not a delivered fix. Reproduction harness: /tmp/mu-registry-outage-check.py; it constructs fresh mu.cue fixtures, a blackhole HTTP server, and a refused-port endpoint without touching the real registry or user cache.
